name: Activity Badges
description: Sidebar activity indicators (colored dots) showing recent edits/notes per feature. Pulses when new events arrive, fades after a timeout.

name: App Database
description: Global SQLite database at ~/.codeforge/codeforge.db storing projects, sessions, and worktrees. Handles migrations, CRUD queries, and session history (renamed sessions, mode overrides, resume state).

name: App Shell
description: Top-level SolidJS component orchestrating TitleBar, WorktreeTabs, Sidebar, MainPanel (TabBar + view switcher), SessionPane, TerminalPanel, StatusBar, modals (InitRepo, Stale, Merge), CommandPalette, and toast stack. Handles keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+K, Cmd+\, Cmd+J, Cmd+1-4, Esc) and resize-handle drag.

name: App State
description: Global Tauri-managed state: app DB, per-repo runtimes (index, timeline, daemon), session manager, session-to-repo mappings, and terminal manager. Shared across all commands.

name: Branch Listing
description: Parses git branch -vv output into structured BranchInfo (local, remote, tracking, detached). Supports fetch-remotes and worktree-for-branch lookups for the branch switcher UI.

name: Claude Session Sidecar
description: Node.js process wrapping @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query(). Communicates via NDJSON over stdin/stdout with commands (query, approval_response, set_mode, abort) and events (text_delta, tool_use_start, approval_request, session_ready, usage, etc.).

name: Cold-Start Indexing
description: Headless claude -p decomposition pass that maps a repository into features. Emits progress (scan → decompose → validate → docs), validates candidate features, runs concurrency-capped per-feature doc passes, and returns the final feature set.

name: Command Palette
description: Cmd+K fuzzy command palette: open repo, start session, toggle terminal, switch view, pin feature, re-index. Keyboard navigation (arrows, Enter, Esc) and icon-coded command groups.

name: Composer
description: Session input area: textarea with auto-resize, Cmd+Enter to submit, Esc to blur, @file mention hints, and local draft persistence. Handles approval responses and multi-line input.

name: Context Slice
description: Manages active repo context (features, active feature, active view) and view-switching logic. Keyed by repo path so switching repos resets the context.

name: Daemon HTTP Server
description: Per-repo local HTTP daemon on 127.0.0.1:0. Axum routes: POST /hooks/event, GET /api/features, GET /api/timeline, POST /api/notes, GET /api/classify. Writes daemon.json with port/pid/started_at.

name: Data Slice
description: Fetches and caches repo data: features, timeline events, diff-by-feature. Polls timeline for new events and emits frontend notifications when the active feature has activity.

name: Diff-by-Feature Grouping
description: Groups extracted FileDiffs by feature slug via classify_paths. Files in multiple features appear in each group with shared: true; unmatched files land in the unmapped group.

name: Diff Review View
description: Feature-grouped diff review: pending changes organized by feature (from diff_by_feature). Collapsible feature groups, per-file hunks with syntax highlighting, and an unmapped section for unclassified files.

name: Doc Refresh Worker
description: Subscribes to the timeline, spawns living-doc refresh tasks for Stop events, and runs them concurrently with a cap. Aborted on daemon shutdown via JoinSet kill_on_drop.

name: Domain Model
description: Shared domain types and serde contracts for Feature, TimelineEvent, DiffByFeature, SessionInfo, and other core entities that cross the Tauri IPC boundary. Pure data structures with no IO, used by all other crates.

name: Feature Classification
description: Maps changed file paths to feature slugs via exact file match or nearest-directory heuristic. Used to group diffs by feature and decide which features to notify on edits.

name: Feature Color Picker
description: Assigns consistent HSL colors to features based on slug hash. Handles group-level color inheritance for nested features. Used by graph view and timeline activity badges.

name: Feature Detail View
description: Main panel view showing a single feature: description, tags, entry points, file list (grouped by role), and recent activity feed. Supports inline editing (name, description, tags) with optimistic UI + autosave.

name: Feature Index Storage
description: In-memory feature index backed by `.codeforge/features.json`. Handles load/save, upsert, pin, merge-reindex (preserving pinned entries), and patch operations. JSON is pretty-printed and slug-sorted for stable diffs.

name: Feature Tree Sidebar
description: Renders the feature tree with collapsible groups, feature rows, activity badges (recent edits/notes), and pinned-feature indicators. Handles row click (navigate to feature), pin/unpin, and group expand/collapse.

name: Feature Validation
description: Parses claude's JSON output into Feature structs, validates that files exist, clamps paths to repo-relative, and filters out invalid candidates. Also derives multi-level groups from file paths.

name: Git Diff Extraction
description: Shells out to git to extract the full pending diff (status --porcelain=v2 + diff HEAD). Parses unified diffs into hunks, synthesizes all-added diffs for untracked text files, and truncates oversized diffs.

name: Git Worktree Management
description: Create, list, remove, and merge git worktrees. Handles branch-already-checked-out errors, detached-HEAD cases, and auto-deletes temp worktrees on clean merges. Refuses to remove the base worktree.

name: Global App Store
description: SolidJS store managing global app state: repo identity, active view/feature, sidebar/session-pane/terminal-panel visibility, sessions list, toasts, modals, worktree switcher. Orchestrates context-slice, data-slice, session-slice, and terminal-slice.

name: Graph View
description: Force-directed graph visualization of features (nodes) and shared files (edges). Canvas-based rendering with zoom/pan, physics simulation, node popover showing feature details, and color-coded nodes by group.

name: Hook Ingestion
description: Receives Claude Code hook payloads from forward.sh, appends timeline events, classifies changed files, and queues unmatched paths for re-index. Spools payloads to disk when the daemon is down.

name: Index Staleness Detection
description: Compares on-disk index version and manifest content-hash to detect when a re-index is needed. Reads features.json and index-meta.json without running claude or re-indexing.

name: Indexing Runtime
description: Spawns the cold-start indexer in a tokio task, streams progress events to frontend, merges results into the index, writes features.json and index-meta.json, and clears the reindex queue on success.

name: Init Repo Modal
description: Modal offering to git-init a non-git directory when the user tries to open it. Calls git init -b main and then proceeds with the normal repo-open flow.

name: Integration Kit Installer
description: Idempotent installer that merges hooks into .claude/settings.json, registers forge-mcp in .mcp.json, appends marker-delimited sections to CLAUDE.md, and scaffolds .codeforge/hooks/forward.sh.

name: IPC Bridge
description: Type-safe Tauri IPC wrappers (invoke, listen) for all commands and events. Mirrors backend command signatures and domain types in TypeScript.

name: Living Doc Refresh
description: Spawns headless claude to refresh one feature's living doc when Stop hooks fire. Runs outside the re-index critical path and only touches docs for features mentioned in the session.

name: MCP Server Registry
description: Locates the user's MCP settings file (~/.claude/mcp.json or ~/AppData/Roaming/Claude/mcp.json) so the sidecar can inherit configured MCP servers.

name: MCP Stdio Server
description: Standalone stdio MCP server binary (forge-mcp) exposing list_features, get_feature, which_features, feature_timeline, and record_note tools. Reads daemon.json to proxy HTTP calls to the daemon.

name: Merge Result Panel
description: Bottom-edge panel showing the outcome of a worktree merge: clean merge (success toast), conflicts (file list), or merge error (stderr). Dismisses after a timeout or user click.

name: Message Stream
description: Renders the session's message history: user prompts, assistant text/thinking, tool use cards, approval requests, and session lifecycle events. Auto-scrolls to bottom, supports markdown rendering, and handles code blocks with syntax highlighting.

name: Mode Control
description: Dropdown UI for switching session permission mode (default, acceptEdits, plan, bypassPermissions). Mode changes apply to the next turn and are persisted in the DB.

name: Reindex Queue
description: Durable SQLite queue (.codeforge/runtime/reindex-queue.db) of pending re-index requests. Each edit to an unmapped file enqueues; the UI shows a prompt when the queue is non-empty.

name: Repo Open Flow
description: Coordinates repo open: loads index and timeline, starts daemon, installs integration kit, spawns indexing runtime, writes project to DB, and returns repo identity + index status to frontend.

name: Session Event Forwarding
description: Subscribes to SessionManager events and forwards them to the Tauri frontend via session:event emissions. Runs as a spawned tokio task per session.

name: Session Header Controls
description: Session header bar with rename input, past sessions dropdown, stop button, and mode indicator. Handles session switching and cleanup on stop.

name: Session Lifecycle
description: Spawns and manages one sidecar process per session. Handles stdin command writes, stdout event reads, stdio EOF detection, process kill, shell-env resolution, and graceful shutdown with abort.

name: Session Manager
description: Manages all live ClaudeSessions: start, stop, send input, approve requests, set mode, list. Forwards session events to Tauri frontend and appends SessionStart/Stop events to the timeline.

name: Session Mode Control
description: Represents the four SDK permission modes (default, acceptEdits, plan, bypassPermissions) and parses them from strings for Tauri IPC and DB storage.

name: Session Pane
description: Right-hand collapsible pane embedding live Claude Code sessions. Shows message stream, composer input, mode control (default/acceptEdits/plan/bypass), approval requests, slash menu, and session header with rename/stop.

name: Session Protocol
description: Rust types and NDJSON protocol codec for the sidecar stdin commands (QueryCommand, ApprovalResponse, SetModeCommand, AbortCommand) and stdout events (AgentEvent). Handles mode inference (fresh/resume/continue) from DB state.

name: Session Slice
description: Manages embedded claude sessions: start, stop, send input, approve/deny requests, set mode, rename. Listens to session:event emissions from backend and updates UI state.

name: Stale Index Detection
description: Compares on-disk index version/hash to detect staleness. When stale, emits a frontend event that triggers the StaleModal UI prompt asking the user to re-index.

name: Stale Index Modal
description: Modal prompting the user to re-index when the on-disk index version/hash is stale. Triggered by staleness detection on repo open or after a pull.

name: Status Bar
description: Bottom status bar showing repo identity (name, branch, head), daemon status (port, uptime), and reindex-pending indicator. Clicking the indicator opens the re-index modal.

name: Tab Bar
description: Top view-switcher tabs: Feature, Graph, Timeline, Diff. Keyboard shortcuts Cmd+1/2/3/4 to switch. Active tab is highlighted.

name: Tauri Config
description: Tauri app configuration: identifier, version, window settings, plugins (dialog, shell, process), security CSP, and build settings (frontend devUrl, beforeDevCommand).

name: Tauri IPC Commands
description: Tauri command handlers for repo (open, init, close, reindex, daemon_status), features (get, pin, update, set_color), timeline (get, diff_by_feature), sessions (start, send, approve, stop, list, rename), worktrees (list, create, remove, merge), and terminals (open, write, resize, close).

name: Terminal Panel
description: Bottom-docked terminal panel hosting xterm.js instances. Tab bar for switching between terminals, close buttons, and auto-fit on resize. Spawned via Cmd+J.

name: Terminal PTY Manager
description: Manages portable-pty terminal instances. Spawns shell processes, reads output to broadcast channels, handles resize, write, close, and emits output events to the Tauri frontend.

name: Terminal Slice
description: Manages terminal instances: open, write, resize, close. Listens to terminal:output events from backend and forwards them to TerminalInstance components.

name: Timeline Storage
description: Append-only per-repo event log backed by SQLite at `.codeforge/runtime/timeline.db`. Supports append, query by filter (feature/actor/kind/since/before_id), and live subscriptions via tokio broadcast channels.

name: Timeline View
description: Chronological event feed showing all edits, notes, sessions, and hooks across the repo. Filter bar (actor, kind, feature), live event subscription, infinite scroll (Load older), and per-event icons/summaries.

name: Title Bar
description: Custom window title bar with project identity badges (shown when multiple projects are open), traffic-light window controls, and drag region. Handles multi-project context switching.

name: Worktree Filesystem Ops
description: Low-level worktree utilities: compute target paths for new worktrees, clean up empty parent dirs on remove, and handle OS-specific path canonicalization.

name: Worktree Switcher
description: Modal branch/worktree picker with fuzzy search, create-new-worktree flow, and safe-close warning when the worktree has uncommitted changes. Shows local/remote branches, tracking info, and worktree paths.

name: Worktree Tabs
description: Top-edge worktree tabs showing all worktrees for the current repo (main + linked). Clicking a tab switches context (emits worktree:switch), close button removes worktree, and + button opens the worktree switcher.
